title: Psalm 29
firstLine: O give to Jehovah, you sons of the Mighty, both glory and strength to Jehovah accord! O give to Jehovah His greatness of glory! In splendor of holiness worship the Lord!

tuneRef.title: We Praise Thee, O God, Our Redeemer

lines: O give to Jehovah, you sons of the Mighty, both glory and strength to Jehovah accord! O give to Jehovah His greatness of glory! In splendor of holiness worship the Lord!
The voice of Jehovah resounds on the waters; the glorious God thunders forth from the height. Jehovah is on the great sweep of the waters - The Lord's voice in splendor! The Lord's voice in might!
The voice of Jehovah is breaking the cedars! Jehovah rips Lebanon's cedars apart! The slopes of Mount Hermon - like calves they are leaping! And Lebanon's hills like young antelope start!
The voice of Jehovah divides flames of lightning and causes the fiery flashes to break! The voice of the Lord makes the wilderness tremble; the Lord makes the desert of Kadesh to shake!
